name: Charts AI Agents
description: AI agents for helping to build charts within Drupal using the Charts module.
project_description: The Charts AI Agents module provides an AI Agent plugin that extends the Views Agent from the AI Agents module so a chosen AI provider can generate Drupal Views rendered with the Charts module's chart style. Given a natural-language prompt, the agent decides whether to create, edit, delete or answer questions about a view, picks the entity type/bundle, fields, filters and chart settings (library, chart type, axes, data providers, colors), and saves the resulting View entity. It runs through the AI Agents Explore page or the AI Chatbot block, and requires the AI Agents framework (with a configured AI provider) plus the Charts module and one Charts rendering sub-module such as Charts Highcharts.
